description: Laws written from their figures by a schedule: the TS draftLaw's answers, which the Rust draft_law gives too (scripts/port-law-cases.ts).

data.title: the law on rent increases

review.label: least time between increases
review.description: The least time between one increase of a tenancy's rent and the next.

notice.label: notice of an increase
notice.description: The least written notice a tenant must have of an increase.

data.text: << ;;A residential rent may be increased no more than once every {review}.;;A residential rent may be increased only on written notice to the tenant of at least {notice}.>> Or else: the increase is invalid.

adico.condition: <<, or ;;more than once in {review};;on written notice of less than {notice}>>

out.text: A residential rent may be increased no more than once every 1 month. A residential rent may be increased only on written notice to the tenant of at least 45 days. Or else: the increase is invalid.

adico.condition: more than once in 1 month, or on written notice of less than 45 days

data.title: the law on industrial action

turnout.label: turnout a ballot needs
turnout.description: The least share of the members concerned who must vote, in percent, as a whole number.

majority.label: share of the votes that must be exceeded
majority.description: The share of the votes cast that the yes votes must exceed, in percent, as a whole number.

notice.label: notice to the employer
notice.description: The least written notice the employer must have of the action.

data.text: Industrial action is protected only where each of these holds. << ;;At least {turnout}% of the members concerned have voted in a ballot on it.;;More than {majority}% of the votes in a ballot of the members concerned are for it.;;The employer has had written notice of it of at least {notice}.>>

adico.condition: <<, or ;;without at least {turnout}% of the members concerned voting in a ballot on it;;without more than {majority}% of a ballot's votes for it;;without written notice to the employer of at least {notice}>>

out.text: Industrial action is protected only where each of these holds. At least 5% of the members concerned have voted in a ballot on it. More than 12% of the votes in a ballot of the members concerned are for it. The employer has had written notice of it of at least 60 days.

adico.condition: without at least 5% of the members concerned voting in a ballot on it, or without more than 12% of a ballot's votes for it, or without written notice to the employer of at least 60 days

data.title: the law on ending a tenancy

notice.label: a landlord's notice to end a tenancy
notice.description: The least written notice a landlord must give to end a tenancy.

tenant_notice.label: a tenant's notice to leave
tenant_notice.description: The notice a tenant may leave on.

data.text: << ;;A landlord may end a tenancy only by giving written notice of at least {notice}, and may not remove a tenant before the notice has run out. Or else: the removal is unlawful and the tenant may return.;;A tenant may leave on notice of {tenant_notice}.>>

adico.condition: <<;;before written notice of at least {notice} has run out>>
adico.or_else: the removal is unlawful; the tenant may return

out.text: A landlord may end a tenancy only by giving written notice of at least 30 days, and may not remove a tenant before the notice has run out. Or else: the removal is unlawful and the tenant may return. A tenant may leave on notice of 45 days.

adico.condition: before written notice of at least 30 days has run out
adico.or_else: the removal is unlawful; the tenant may return
